reason: I forget my pills at home whenever I travel, and a counted sachet I can toss in my bag fixes that. The named lab and batch report make me trust it more, and $24.99 for one box is an easy trial.
objection: It is still 2 capsules every day, and $29.99 after launch is more than the plain magnesium I could grab at the store. I would not buy two boxes until I know it works for me.
would_change_my_mind: If the regular price stayed above $30 or I found the lab report was vague, I would pass.
